items.title: Italian Competition Watchdog Launches Suno Investigation ‘Over Unfair Terms,’ Says ‘The Contractual Provisions on Copyright Deserve Particular Attention’
items.summary: La Autoridad Italiana de Competencia ha abierto una investigación formal contra Suno, alegando cláusulas contractuales injustas y destacando la necesidad de revisar las disposiciones de derechos de autor, en medio de varias demandas internacionales y reclamos de copyright.

items.title: Sony Music’s AI Slop and Deepfakes Crackdown Intensifies — Soundalike Track Removal Requests Reportedly Top 250,000
items.summary: Sony Music ha intensificado su lucha contra deepfakes y pistas imitativas, enviando más de 250 000 solicitudes de eliminación a diversas plataformas hasta finales de septiembre, según un informe del Financial Times que indica una campaña de cumplimiento en aumento.

items.title: A US appeals court has rejected a ‘fair use’ defense over AI training. What does it mean for the labels’ fight with Suno?
Japanese court says voice is protected by publicity rights; US appeals court says AI training is not fair use
items.summary: There have been two judgments this week of relevance to the ongoing AI debates in the music industry. A Japanese court ruled that publicity rights allow performers to stop unapproved AI voice clones. Meanwhile a US appeals court ruled against an AI company that used the good old fair use defence

Trump’s DoJ was biased and wrong about ‘fair use’, say news orgs in OpenAI dispute
items.summary: Many of the music industry’s AI legal battles swing on whether or not AI training is ‘fair use’ under US copyright law. Donald Trump’s DoJ recently intervened in a dispute between newspapers and OpenAI insisting AI training is fair use. The newspapers have responded, explaining why the DoJ is wrong

items.title: Elon Musk says X’s AI-bot Grok will use Suno for music tasks
items.summary: You’d be forgiven for trying to avoid most of Elon Musk’s tweets, particularly when he gets on a late-night posting burst. But one of his latest has direct relevance to music. The post is from Music Ally .

tip.title: Guarda los proyectos, no solo el master
tip.body: En una disputa de autoría, el archivo de sesión de tu DAW con fecha, stems y versiones intermedias pesa más que el WAV final. Respalda el proyecto completo, no nada más el bounce.

items.title: Italian Competition Watchdog Launches Suno Investigation ‘Over Unfair Terms,’ Says ‘The Contractual Provisions on Copyright Deserve Particular Attention’
items.summary: Italy’s Competition Authority has launched a formal probe into Suno, alleging unfair contractual clauses and emphasizing scrutiny of copyright provisions, while the AI music generator also faces multiple U.S. lawsuits and international copyright claims.

items.title: Sony Music’s AI Slop and Deepfakes Crackdown Intensifies — Soundalike Track Removal Requests Reportedly Top 250,000
items.summary: Sony Music has stepped up its crackdown on AI deepfakes and soundalike tracks, filing over 250,000 takedown requests with various platforms by the end of September, a figure reported by the Financial Times reflecting heightened enforcement efforts.

tip.title: Keep the project files, not just the master
tip.body: In an authorship dispute, your dated DAW session with stems and work-in-progress versions carries more weight than the final WAV. Back up the whole project, not just the bounce.
